message: No detected input validation: The code only checks that 'image' key exists and filename is non-empty, but does not validate file type, extension, MIME type, image dimensions, or content integrity before processing.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data comes from local file uploads or local disk files; there is no fetching from remote sources, and no checksum or signature verification is performed on any loaded file.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool used anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples or uploaded images before processing.

No detected model integrity verification: Both CNN.py and SVM.py load serialized model files (e.g., 'CNN_Model.pkl') using pickle without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity before loading.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads datasets via image_dataset_from_directory and prints image count, but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/TensorFlow training with no DP-SGD, Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics; evaluation is purely inference-time prediction with no metric tracking or integrity controls.

No detected input sanitization: Only `secure_filename` and a non-empty filename check are performed; there is no validation of file type (MIME type or extension whitelist), image dimensions, file size limits, or content integrity before passing the file to the model pipeline.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (denomination from CNN and prediction from SVM) are used directly in the response string with no probability/confidence threshold checks, NaN guards, or sanity validation of returned values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses image-based CNN and SVM models, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
